meta.title: fix: 优化数据库事务处理以减少死锁和超时
meta.body_summary: Optimize database transaction handling by splitting long transactions, reducing Redis lock timeouts, and separating long-running LLM operations from DB commits to reduce deadlocks and timeouts under high concurrency.

perf_labels.notes: Devin split transactions for lock reduction; maintainer yfge closed due to loss of API-level rollback when LLM errors occur.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1840 changed lines across 7 files, this is a medium-to-large refactor by absolute volume (majority in runscript.py, utils.py, and test scripts). As a transaction optimization performance PR, it was closed—not merged—because the maintainer identified a critical design flaw that broke interface-level rollback guarantees.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer yfge commented that splitting transactions and committing early would prevent interface-level rollback if an LLM call errors, breaking atomicity of the overall operation.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce database deadlocks and timeouts under high concurrency by using smaller nested transactions, shorter Redis lock timeouts, and separating long LLM operations from DB commits.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR after raising functional rollback concern; no follow-up fixes were attempted.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin split long transactions to reduce locking but failed to preserve the required atomic rollback across the LLM call; this boundary reflects the need for deep transactional semantics awareness in Python/Flask/SQLAlchemy.

detection_detail.code_reading: yfge reviewed the PR and flagged that early commits would prevent rollback if LLM call fails, citing a specific scenario.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR provides load test scripts but no performance metrics or evidence that deadlocks are reduced; maintainer's functional concern was about correctness, not performance verification.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer closed the PR without merging; no attempt to fix the rollback issue within the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Split large transactions in run_script_inner, get_script, and reset_user_study_info_by_lesson into smaller nested transactions using db.session.begin_nested() and commit() after each operation; reduced Redis lock timeout to 30s and block timeout to 3s in run_with_redis; separated long LLM runs from DB commits in run_script; added load test scripts.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Load test scripts added to validate concurrency and monitor DB, but not used to produce performance evidence before close.
change_trajectory: Initial commits: optimize run_script_inner, reset_user_study_info, run_with_redis, and get_script with smaller transactions.
Add load test scripts for concurrency testing.
Maintainer yfge commented about loss of rollback; PR closed without further changes.
